Updated and detailed review - February 2026. Flipped used to be fantastic. Not anymore. Flipped has the potential to be the absolute best out there, but it feels like a sinking ship right now. There are too many changes and updates that are never tested or thought through before implementation, and the user experience is suffering badly because of it. There are WAY too many bugs that are NEVER addressed. There are too many paywalls for users and creators who are already top-tier subscribers. Due to a recent update that allow “creators” to use AI to create their characters, Flipped is now FLOODED with generic, AI written characters that have ZERO personality and ZERO creativity whatsoever, making it difficult to sift and search to find characters that have actually been thoughtfully created by creative and talented creators. The long term AI memory is basically non-existent, even though long term memory is a supposed perk for top-tier subscribers. The chat model has changed so drastically, now all characters basically respond in the exact same manner unless using a paywalled chat response mode, over and above the top-tier subscription. The AI is hyper-sexualized and extremely inconsistent, rarely following a set character story or persona, which absolutely wrecks character, story, and chat continuity. The discord community is a toxic cesspool that has been all but forgotten and ignored by Flipped. I could go on and on, but you get the picture. On the bright side, the Flipped app does have a really nice UI that makes it feel premium and exclusive, though it’s not without its minor downsides either. Things used to be much more naturally intuitive, but once again, too many changes have made a lot of those things much less intuitive. I’ve spent an obscene amount of time using Flipped to create and chat with Flipped characters, so this review comes from someone with long term experience on the platform and somewhat of a vested interest, especially from a performance standpoint of my own characters.

W app. Just plain GOOD. The basically unlimited messages are great for keeping a conversation going- don’t listen to reviews that say messaging is limited, they’re not real. 
 There are all sorts of characters to talk to, and the AI is very adaptive, skilled at depicting emotions and complex, with different characters even responding differently to prompts based on their pre-coded ‘personalities,’ which makes them feel more lifelike. 
 Bugs are very limited, and you can always rewind or refresh a message the AI sent and it usually catches its own mistakes when it messages again. Again, take other reviews with a grain of salt (stay skeptical)- not every interaction is overtly sexual, and some characters will actually try their best to change the subject if you come on too hard, especially if you were just talking about something normal with a different AI. The bots are very complex and theorizing about philosophy and existentialism with 2B is one of my favorite past times on here. Which character you are talking to has a big influence on their reactions. 
 Finally, the AI image manipulation and generation being locked behind a paywall subscription makes sense given how much the app offers for free, and is a nice complimentary feature for people who want to pay a little to get a little more out of the app. 
However at the end of the day, this app knows what it is, and you know what you’re looking for in downloading it and if a steamy AI chat app is what you’re wanting, this is definitely the best of its kind on the market. 

If I had any suggestions for improvement, it would be for the devs to embrace what the app is. People come here looking for crazy hot romance stories, fantasies that they can’t live out themselves who why not just fill it with that? Too many of the characters are basic and mundane, and I’d actually prefer if the majority of interactions were over-the-top fictitious stories. I want to live crazy on here, not have to go home and make dinner with my bland AI spouse, ok? Every character should be an adventure, and right now it feels like I have to force a lot of the more interesting conversations.

 ALSO a few notes for newcomers: swiping left will not remove the character from the pool, they will be an option again once you’ve gone through every character. However, swiping right and then deleting the character from your pending messages will remove them and the only way to chat again is by redownloading the app (which is free).

There are some bugs in it which are unfortunate, but nothing I can’t accept, wait for it to be ironed out, do without for the time, or work around.
